summary: Spire Global, Inc. reported on Form 8-K that its Canadian subsidiary received a termination-for-convenience notice for the WildFireSat contract with the Government of Canada, effective immediately. The contract, valued at up to Can$71.8 million, was for satellite constellation design and development for wildfire monitoring. Spire may submit a settlement proposal for termination costs by May 7, 2026. This is a government contract termination, not a corporate deal category. The filing triggers no M&A or capital markets event; focus is on settlement recovery and lost revenue impact.
